current_issues.required_change: Reject every value for which propellerPitchAtMcrBollard is not exactly equal to 0.7 times propellerPitchAtMcrFreeRunning; remove the tolerance allowance.
current_issues.regression_guard: Preserve the CP and pitchValueKnown=false applicability conditions and the metre-quantity operands while enforcing exact equality.
